'''Arbooine''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], inhabited by the [[Sathari/Legends|Sathari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Quolas]] was a tree-city on the planet.<ref name="In the Footsteps of a Master" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] believed there were [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] bases located among the forest.<ref name="Scars of War">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2015/9/28/scars-of-war|text=Scars of War}}</ref>

The planet was named by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] explorer after he found the native name unpronounceable.<ref name="CotG" />
